Harness

How Rainbow plugs into your harness

Choose a tier. The task files, tool interface and verifier are the same in each; only the world behind the API changes.

your sidevisible to the agentworldhidden from the agent

Echo · hosted simulation. Your runner, agent and trainer stay on your side. The environment, world model and verifier run on GD Byte Infra, reached through a secure session API. The agent sees the instruction and tool results only; the verifier runs in a separate sandbox after the episode. Seconds per step, for training at scale.

Live · real lab. Available on request during the pilot. Runs only in our lab, as a hosted session. The task files, tool interface and verifier are the same as Echo. Observations are real measurements, every command passes a hardware safety check, and you receive the full trajectory with raw instrument data. Minutes per step, for grounding and final evaluation.

Evaluation data

Example item

A diffraction question in the format our evaluation sets use. Reading a plot looks easy; ranking peaks correctly is where multimodal models still fail.

Example · XRD relative intensity · multiple choice

What is the correct order of peak positions (2θ) from lowest to highest intensity in the XRD pattern shown?

  • A44.9, 38.6, 78.6
  • B44.9, 78.6, 38.6
  • C78.6, 38.6, 44.9
  • D ✓78.6, 44.9, 38.6

Why it is hard: models find the tallest peak easily but often misorder the smaller ones, scoring close to random on this task type.
